name: Woodwork
description: Cabinets and furniture in sheet goods: carcass generator and cut list.

units.title: Units
units.description: Unit of the sizes below. The values shown at first are mm: with in, enter each size in inches.

back.title: Back
back.description: groove: back panel in a groove 12 mm from the rear. overlay: back panel fixed on the rear edges. none: open back.

dividers.title: Dividers
dividers.description: Vertical dividers, splitting the inside into equal compartments.

shelves.title: Shelves
shelves.description: Shelves in each compartment, evenly spaced.

drawers.title: Drawers
drawers.description: A stack of equal drawers with overlay fronts, boxes sized for 12.7 mm slides. Shelves are then left out; not with doors or dividers.

plinth.title: Plinth height
plinth.description: 0 for none. The plinth board sits 50 mm back from the front.

shelf_pins.title: Shelf pin holes
shelf_pins.description: 32 mm system: rows of 5 mm holes 37 mm from the front and back. The shelves rest on them.

doors.title: Doors
doors.description: Overlay doors with 35 mm hinge cup holes and 2 mm gaps: 0, 1, 2, or one per compartment (dividers + 1).

handles.title: Handle holes
handles.description: 5 mm screw holes through the doors and drawer fronts. knob: one hole. pull: two, 128 mm apart. On a door they are on the opening side: near the top on a floor unit (it has a plinth or is 450 mm deep or more), near the bottom on a wall unit, at mid-height on a door over 1200 mm.

handle_position.title: Handle position
handle_position.description: Where on a door the handle holes go. top and bottom: 100 mm from that end. middle: at mid-height. auto: near the top on a floor unit (it has a plinth or is 450 mm deep or more), near the bottom on a wall unit, at mid-height on a door over 1200 mm. Drawer fronts always get theirs in the middle.

match.title: Match selected
match.description: selected: height, depth, panel thickness and plinth are not read from this dialog but linked to the cabinet that is selected (select any part of it first). Change them on that cabinet later and this one follows.

material.title: Material
material.description: Board material of every panel. Change it later with Material on a selection.

place.title: Place
place.description: origin: centred on the origin. right, left, above: against the cabinet that is selected (select any part of it first), backs flush. right is against its right side and left against its left side, so on the return's side of a corner cabinet the new one is turned to continue the return.

name.title: Name
name.description: Prefix for the panel names. A name that is taken gets the next free number: Cabinet, Cabinet 2, Cabinet 3.

units.title: Units
units.description: Unit of the sizes below. The values shown at first are mm: with in, enter each size in inches.

corner.title: Corner
corner.description: L-shaped cabinet for a corner of the room. left: the corner is at the back left, and the return runs forward along the left wall. right: the mirror image.

shape.title: Shape
shape.description: L-shaped: two fronts at a right angle, with a bi-fold pair of doors. diagonal: one front straight across the open corner at 45 degrees, with one door.

width.title: Width
width.description: Along the back wall, from the corner.

return.title: Return
return.description: Along the side wall, from the corner.

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: Depth of both legs, wall to front. diagonal: the depth at the end of the width; at the end of the return it is width - return + depth, so the same when width and return are equal.

plinth.title: Plinth height
plinth.description: 0 for none. The plinth sits 50 mm back from the fronts.

shelf_pins.title: Shelf pin holes
shelf_pins.description: 32 mm system: rows of 5 mm holes in both ends and both backs. The shelves rest on them.

doors.title: Doors
doors.description: Overlay doors with 35 mm hinge cup holes, hinged on the cabinet at its left or its right end, as you face the corner. L-shaped: a bi-fold pair, one door on each front; the first closes the inner corner and the second is hinged to it there. diagonal: one door.

handles.title: Handle holes
handles.description: 5 mm screw holes. L-shaped: through the door that folds, beside the fold. diagonal: on the door's opening edge. knob: one hole. pull: two, 128 mm apart. Near the top on a floor unit (it has a plinth or is 450 mm deep or more), near the bottom on a wall unit, at mid-height on a door over 1200 mm.

handle_position.title: Handle position
handle_position.description: Where on a door the handle holes go. top and bottom: 100 mm from that end. middle: at mid-height. auto: near the top on a floor unit (it has a plinth or is 450 mm deep or more), near the bottom on a wall unit, at mid-height on a door over 1200 mm.

match.title: Match selected
match.description: selected: height, depth, panel thickness and plinth are not read from this dialog but linked to the cabinet that is selected (select any part of it first). Change them on that cabinet later and this one follows.

material.title: Material
material.description: Board material of every panel. Change it later with Material on a selection.

place.title: Place
place.description: origin: centred on the origin. right, left, above: against the cabinet that is selected (select any part of it first), backs flush. right is against its right side and left against its left side, whichever way it is turned.

name.title: Name
name.description: Prefix for the panel names. A name that is taken gets the next free number: Corner, Corner 2.

type.title: Type
type.description: Drills where the sides meet the bottom and top of the cabinet you selected a part of. confirmat: 7 mm through the side and a 5 mm pilot for 7 x 50 screws. dowel: 8 mm holes for 8 x 35 dowels.

scope.title: Apply to
scope.description: cabinet: every panel of the cabinet you selected a part of. parts: only the selected parts, such as the doors.
